g.text: Fewer models stay unreleased; access increasingly runs through an API

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: What it shows: how each year's notable models were released — open weights, behind an API, hosted without an API, or never

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: released at all. The access question, answered from the record rather than from impression.

g.text: Methodology: Methodology reference pending final methodology document; derivation follows Epoch AI's published AI models documentation

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Note: Shares of the models published that year that carry an accessibility value; models with none are absent from the column entirely, and

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: the count behind each column is printed above it. Epoch's categories distinguish unrestricted open weights from non-commercial and

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: restricted-use releases, and those are kept separate here rather than collapsed into one open bucket. The final year is partial.

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Accessibility is recorded as of Epoch's last update to the row, so a model whose licence changed later still shows its recorded

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280
